title: Path-dependent McKean PDEs with reaction: a discussion on probabilistic interpretations and particle approximations
summary: In this paper, we discuss and compare two probabilistic approaches for associating a stochastic differential equation with a McKean-type partial differential equation featuring a reaction term and path-dependent coefficients.
